nea-hackerone:ashbyhq:4ba3af14-e8c5-451b.title: Associate General Counsel - Global Commercial Lead
nea-hackerone:ashbyhq:4ba3af14-e8c5-451b.descriptionHtml:
HackerOne is a global leader in Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). The HackerOne Platform unites agentic AI solutions with the ingenuity of the world’s largest community of security researchers to continuously discover, validate, prioritize, and remediate exposures across code, cloud, and AI systems. Through solutions like bug bounty, vulnerability disclosure, agentic pentesting, AI red teaming, and code security, HackerOne delivers measurable, continuous reduction of cyber risk for enterprises. Industry leaders, including Anthropic, Crypto.com, General Motors, Goldman Sachs, Lufthansa, Uber, UK Ministry of Defence, and the U.S. Department of Defense, trust HackerOne to safeguard their digital ecosystems. HackerOne was recognized in Gartner’s Emerging Tech Impact Radar: AI Cybersecurity Ecosystem report for its leadership in AI Security Testing and has been named a Most Loved Workplace for Young Professionals (2024).

HackerOne is at a pivotal inflection point in the security industry. Offensive security is no longer optional – it is the standard for forward-thinking companies that want to build trust and resilience in a world where AI-driven innovation and adversaries are moving faster than ever. With the industry shifting, HackerOne stands apart: we combine the ingenuity of the largest security research community with a best-in-class AI-powered platform, trusted by the world’s top organizations.

HackerOne Values

HackerOne is dedicated to fostering a strong and inclusive culture. HackerOne is Customer Obsessed and prioritizes customer outcomes in our decisions and actions. We Default to Disclosure by operating with transparency and integrity, ensuring trust and accountability. Employees, researchers, customers, and partners Win Together by fostering empowerment, inclusion, respect, and accountability.

Associate General Counsel - Global Commercial Lead

Remote Locations

UK: London

USA: Seattle, San Francisco Bay Area, Austin, Washington DC, or Boston

Position Summary

HackerOne is redefining offensive security for the AI era. As organizations accelerate digital transformation and AI innovation, trust has become the ultimate competitive advantage. We are at the center of that shift - combining the world’s largest community of security researchers with an AI-powered platform trusted by global enterprises and governments.

We are seeking a Director, Commercial Legal to lead and scale our global commercial legal function at a pivotal moment in our growth. Reporting to the Chief Legal Officer, you will shape how Legal enables enterprise expansion, international growth, and AI-driven product innovation - while setting the global standards for risk, velocity, and operational excellence.

This is not a maintenance role. It is a scale role. You will architect the legal frameworks, systems, and leadership bench that allow HackerOne to grow faster and smarter - building a department that is globally consistent, commercially sharp, and operationally modern.

At HackerOne, we embrace a Flexible Work approach that gives us the freedom to do our best work while also fostering the connections and community that make us stronger. Reflecting this philosophy, this is a remote role targeted for candidates within ~50 miles of any of the above locations. We believe this balance of proximity and flexibility gives Hackeronies the chance to occasionally come together – fostering collaboration, connection, and in-person moments that enrich our culture – while still preserving the benefits of remote work.

What You Will Lead

Global Commercial Strategy & Execution

  • Own and scale the global commercial legal function across North America, EMEA, and APAC.

  • Establish clear commercial risk standards and negotiation frameworks that balance enterprise growth with disciplined governance.

  • Serve as the final decision authority on commercial risk within defined thresholds, partnering with the CLO on enterprise-level matters.

  • Support complex enterprise transactions across regulated industries and international markets.

Department Leadership & Scale

  • Build and develop a high-performing, multi-jurisdictional team across commercial, privacy, and procurement legal support.

  • Scale leadership capability within the function, creating succession depth and operational independence.

  • Design the legal operating model for international expansion and product growth.

Legal Operations & AI-Enabled Modernization

  • Architect an AI First legal operations strategy that responsibly leverages AI to improve contract review, knowledge management, and workflow automation.

  • Embed Data-Driven Decision Making by establishing measurable KPIs for contract cycle time, risk trends, and negotiation performance.

  • Apply First Principles Problem Solving to eliminate legacy complexity and redesign commercial workflows for scale.

Cross-Functional Executive Partnership

  • Partner with Sales, GTM, Finance, Security, and Product leadership to accelerate deal velocity without compromising integrity.

  • Guide the organization through product launches, regulatory evolution, and global expansion with Change Agility and operational clarity.

  • Translate company strategy into department-level priorities, systems, and measurable outcomes — embodying Own the Outcome at scale.

Multiply the function’s long-term impact through talent development and scalable systems in line with Multiply Your Impact.

Minimum Qualifications  

  • UK/EU or US qualified lawyer.

  • 12+ years of legal experience, including significant in-house leadership experience in technology or SaaS environments.

  • Demonstrated experience leading a commercial legal function or major sub-function at scale.

  • Extensive experience negotiating complex, cross-border enterprise agreements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, defense, public sector).

  • Experience building global legal infrastructure in high-growth or international expansion environments.

  • Experience implementing legal technology and AI-enabled workflow tools.

  • Experience managing external counsel budgets and vendor risk governance frameworks.

Compensation Bands

UK

  • London - £175,000 to £195,000 + equity

USA

  • Tier A (San Francisco Bay Area)

    • $280,000 to $320,000 + equity

  • Tier B: (Seattle, Austin, Washington DC, Boston)

    • $250,000 to $285,000 + equity

  • Tier C: n/a

#LI-MH1

Job Benefits:

  • Health (medical, vision, dental), life, and disability insurance*

  • Equity stock options

  • Retirement plans

  • Paid public holidays and unlimited PTO

  • Paid maternity and parental leave

  • Leaves of absence (including caregiver leave and leave under CO's Healthy Families and Workplaces Act)

  • Employee Assistance Program

*Eligibility may differ by country

We're committed to building a global team! For certain roles outside the United States, India, the U.K., and the Netherlands, we partner with Remote.com as our Employer of Record (EOR).

Visa/work permit sponsorship is not available.

Employment at HackerOne is contingent on a background check.

HackerOne is an Equal Opportunity Employer in the terms and conditions of employment for all employees and job applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, pregnancy, disability or veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by international, federal, state, or local laws.

This policy applies to all HackerOne employment practices, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. HackerOne makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

For US based roles only: Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, all qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records will be considered for the position.

nea-quotewell:ashbyhq:6466bd23-598d-46ed.descriptionHtml:
QuoteWell is building a modern commercial insurance brokerage by combining technology with deep domain expertise. A key part of our vision is an AI assistant powered by emerging LLM techniques that helps brokers anticipate and automate tasks, making their workflows faster, smarter, and more intuitive.

We’re looking for an experienced engineer who wants to shape not just our technology, but also our product direction and business outcomes.

What You’ll Do

  • Build impactful products: Own and deliver features in our all-TypeScript stack (React + Node).

  • Shape product direction: Partner with Product, Design, and Data to define problems, break them down into incremental solutions, and validate with users.

  • Leverage AI in practice: Deliver innovative AI-driven agentic solutions for our insurance experts, designed for a future MCP-driven world.

  • Model complex data: Represent insurance data and relationships in intuitive, user-friendly tools that improve decision-making.

  • Collaborate and grow: Work in a remote-first, flexible, and accountable engineering culture while learning from teammates (and maybe a bit about insurance too).

What You’ll Bring

  • Technical depth: Strong experience with TypeScript, React, and Node (or a very similar stack), and a history of shipping production code.

  • Product impact: A track record of influencing product and business direction through engineering insights.

  • AI curiosity: Familiarity with or interest in applied AI/LLM techniques and how they can power real products.

  • Collaborative skills: Ability to work across the full product lifecycle, specifying features, testing, iterating, and validating with users.

  • Generalist mindset: Willingness to learn new technologies and adapt to what the business needs most.

  • Flexibility to connect in person: Willingness to travel occasionally to Austin or team offsites..

Location: Remote. Our primary hub is located in Austin, TX, and we have remote employees across the United States. We offer flexible co-working arrangements.

We are a remote-first team, with employees distributed across the U.S. We gather quarterly for co-location sessions (about four days each)

What we offer our full-time employees

  • Competitive salaries + equity in the company

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision healthcare benefits + FSA and HSA options

  • Flexible vacation policy to recharge and live life

  • Paid membership to One Medical for employees, spouses / domestic partners, and dependents

  • Company-sponsored 401K plan (Roth & Traditional)

  • Paid parental leave, generous family forming benefits and up to $5,000 of reimbursements through Carrot

  • Up to $1,000 in home office reimbursements to build a productive space to work remotely

  • An opportunity to work on solutions that are redefining the future of commercial insurance

  • A culture driven by a focus on impact, a shared growth mindset, empowered individuals, and integrity

pearvc-pear-vc:ashbyhq:6df5aac6-e0eb-41a.title: AI / ML Engineer - Known
pearvc-pear-vc:ashbyhq:6df5aac6-e0eb-41a.descriptionHtml:
About the Role

You’ll be the technical founder driving the machine learning and AI backbone behind Known — an intelligent, compatibility-driven dating platform that blends psychology, data, and human-like conversation. You’ll design and ship the systems that make Known feel magical: personalized matching algorithms, adaptive recommendation loops, and natural voice/LLM-based interactions that help users connect meaningfully.

You’ll work closely with the founding team (product, platform, and design) to shape both the data and ML foundations and the user-facing experiences that differentiate Known. This is a hands-on role with ownership across research, prototyping, and production deployment.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement multi-stage matching systems (embedding-based retrieval + LLM re-ranking) for compatibility scoring, search, and personalization.

  • Develop and maintain ML pipelines for data ingestion, feature generation, model training, evaluation, and inference.

  • Prototype and productionize agentic workflows for natural-language and voice interactions (e.g., AI-assisted intake interviews, voice matching, or conversation agents).

  • Deploy and monitor ML models in production with guardrails for performance, fairness, and safety.

  • Run offline & online experiments (A/B and multivariate) to measure real-world outcomes such as engagement, match success rate, and conversation quality.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with platform engineers and product designers to integrate AI seamlessly into the Known user experience.

Requirements

  • 3+ years in applied ML or data science engineering roles, ideally working on recommendation, search, or personalization systems.

  • Strong proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, Hugging Face).

  • Experience with LLMs, embeddings, and agentic workflows.

  • Understanding of A/B testing and human-in-the-loop system design for model evaluation in production.

  • Familiarity with ANN search systems and modern MLOps tools is a plus.

  • Reinforcement learning or preference modeling experience is a strong plus.

  • You care about building safe, fair, and human-centered AI experiences.

Example Projects

  • Develop a user matching system based on profile information, onboarding transcripts and engagement behavior.

  • Build a dynamic profile enrichment pipeline that integrates behavioral and linguistic features into user representations.

  • Deploy a lightweight LLM-powered voice agent for user intake and conversational matchmaking.

  • Create an evaluation harness combining offline metrics (AUC, NDCG) and online experiments (match acceptance, message rate).

  • Build model monitoring and retraining loops informed by live interaction feedback.

Why This Role

This is an opportunity to define the technical DNA of a consumer AI product from day one — to architect and deploy systems that combine data science, human psychology, and generative AI. Your work will directly shape how people connect, communicate, and build relationships in an AI-assisted world.

phoenixcourt-goodlord:ashbyhq:cd3a37c2-d.title: Senior Business Systems Analyst
phoenixcourt-goodlord:ashbyhq:cd3a37c2-d.descriptionHtml:
📍 Location: Sheffield City Centre (Fargate)

🖥 Hybrid working as standard: 2 days a week in the office, the other 3 days remote (or office if you prefer)

As part of our commitment to embedding AI across the business, we'd encourage you to share any experience using AI, automation or emerging technologies in your CV or application. We are looking for people who are curious, embrace new technology and can identify opportunities to create business value through AI.

Our mission:

  • Two in five people in the UK rent their homes. Our mission? To be the gold standard platform for renting

  • We started Goodlord because we wanted to make renting simple and transparent for everyone involved: the agent, the landlord, and the tenant. We knew Generation Rent would lead to more tenants, with higher digital expectations and we were confident we could provide a solution

  • Like all scale-ups it’s been a bit of a rollercoaster journey, but we’re now stronger than ever, with around 3,000 letting agents using the platform, exciting and varied products and 350+ Goodlordians across the group supporting the mission!

The Opportunity:

  • Own and optimise Salesforce and key business systems across Sales, Marketing, Support and Finance

  • Partner with stakeholders to improve operational processes and deliver scalable system solutions

  • Drive automation and AI-powered efficiencies using Salesforce’s latest AI capabilities to improve workflows and business performance

  • Work in a fast-paced scale-up environment where you can influence strategy, solve real business problems and make a visible impact

What we need from you:

  • Strong hands-on Salesforce Sales Cloud administration, configuration and automation experience

  • Experience identifying opportunities to use AI and automation to streamline processes and improve operational efficiency

  • Ability to gather requirements, map processes and translate business needs into scalable system solutions

  • Proactive, solutions-focused mindset with experience managing integrations, working cross-functionally and thriving in a changing environment

Why you'll love being a Goodlordian

Aside from the role, the people, our culture and our mission, we have some other things that make Goodlord a pretty awesome place to be. Here’s a few favourites amongst Goodlordians (check out our careers page for more info).

  • Grow with Goodlord: your development is important to us, that’s why we are Great Place to Work - certified. Have a goal in mind? Share it with us so we can use some of our annual development fund to support it. We guarantee you’ll learn loads and develop both personally and professionally!

  • Your well-being matters: bi-weekly coaching with Sanctus to provide Goodlordians with a safe place to talk and support your mental health

  • 25 days holiday (plus UK Bank holidays) plus 1 day per full holiday year up to 32 days: We believe regular breaks are essential for well-being and we encourage (some may say expect!) all Goodlordians to take full advantage of their annual leave entitlement.

  • Supporting your family: we offer Goodlordians of all genders a generous 3 months of fully-paid time off to look after their new arrivals

  • Our team: we’re an energetic, sociable, and talented bunch who are super passionate about what we do and determined to make a difference. We’re all in it together, we learn from each other, we’re genuine and we don’t have time for politics

What’s next?

If you’re ready to help us on our mission to be the gold standard platform for renting, then click apply (2-3 minutes)!

A full job spec is available on request.

Goodlord wants applicants from all backgrounds and walks of life. We are an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment where people can do their best work. If there is anything you need to participate fully in the interview process, we’d love to hear about that - please just include it in your application. Come and join us!


** Please note, as we are regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority, all Goodlordians are required to pass a thorough referencing check via Experian before joining the team. We will only ask for references at the point of making an offer.

Regrettably we are not able to provide sponsorship for this role.

No agencies please - we have tried and trusted partners we would turn to should we require support.

About Hive

Hive is the leading provider of cloud-based AI solutions to understand, search, and generate content, and is trusted by hundreds of the world's largest and most innovative organizations. The company empowers developers with a portfolio of best-in-class, pre-trained AI models, serving billions of customer API requests every month. Hive also offers turnkey software applications powered by proprietary AI models and datasets, enabling breakthrough use cases across industries. Together, Hive’s solutions are transforming content moderation, brand protection, sponsorship measurement, context-based ad targeting, and more.

Hive has raised over $120M in capital from leading investors, including General Catalyst, 8VC, Glynn Capital, Bain & Company, Visa Ventures, and others. We have over 250 employees globally in our San Francisco, Seattle, and Delhi offices. Please reach out if you are interested in joining the future of AI!

Client Partnerships Manager Role

Hive is looking for a strong leader to provide direction, oversight, and management of client partnerships across the board. As a client partnerships manager at Hive, you will work closely with our executive team to support the growth of our business, including working directly with some of our largest clients and partners as well as management of a team of analysts to support business development and client success efforts. Our ideal candidate has strong generalist skills and a proven background of leadership. They are able to step into any role and help out with any project as needed. A passion for startups and AI is a must.
  • Lead the solution design, project delivery, and customer success of high profile enterprise client projects, in partnership with the executive team, in collaboration with engineering / product teams, and with oversight of a 2-3 person business analyst team

sequoia-tacto:ashbyhq:47883882-c0b9-47cf.descriptionHtml:
Your Impact

As an intern at Tacto, you'll have real impact and real ownership. It's important for us to give motivated, ambitious students a steep learning curve and an honest look at what it takes to build one of Europe's fastest-growing startups. We hold interns to the same bar as full-time hires, which means we only bring on people who we trust to lead projects independently and who we'd genuinely want to work with long-term.

The Builder in Residence track is for people who want to build the product itself - the platform, the agents, the integrations, the data layer that procurement teams across Europe rely on. You'll join one of our technical teams - Product, Design, Engineering, or Data Automation – based on where your skills and our needs align. By the end of the program you'll have shipped things to our customers, built alongside strong role models, and walked away with a network that lasts.

Where you might work

Depending on the match, you could join one of these teams:

  • Product – Define what we build and why. Talk to customers, prototype, prioritize, and ship features that move procurement teams from spreadsheets to AI-native operations

  • Design – Own how Tacto looks and feels. Design the patterns for how procurement professionals supervise AI agents - challenges no one has solved before

  • Engineering – Build the platform, the agentic systems, and the infrastructure powering autonomous procurement. Modern stack, high ownership, fast feedback loops

How it Works

  1. You apply once - this application covers all our technical internship positions

  2. Tell us your preferences - rank the areas you're most interested in (we ask in the application form)

  3. First call - we'll come prepared with a clear proposal on which team we think fits best and why. We discuss your skills, our needs, and where you can have the most impact

  4. Case study - if we move forward, you'll work on a technical case with the team lead from your proposed department

  5. We match and place you - you join a specific team & are all set to ship from day 1

Once you're in, you'll work primarily in your team. Depending on interest and capacity, there are usually opportunities to contribute to cross-functional projects as well to broaden your horizon.

We also host regular events with top-tier founders and speakers from the startup ecosystem — e.g. Andreas Klinger at Lunch & Learn, 2-day AI Hackathon in our office, Basti Schuon at Lunch & Learn — so you get exposure to the full picture of building a startup, not just your corner of it.

What you need to work at Tacto

  • Experience in a fast-paced environment (startup, scale-up, strong technical project, whatever pushed you)

  • AI native - you live in Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, v0, Lovable or whatever ships next. You build agents, automate your own workflows, and treat new models as tools to test the day they drop. If your default for a hard problem isn't "let me see what I can do with AI", this isn't the role

  • Self-driven + Naturally curious - you don't need hand-holding

  • A real builder mindset: you've shipped side projects, contributed to OSS, hacked on AI tools, or built something people use

  • Strong communication skills in German and English

  • You care about the problem we are solving & are mission-aligned - helping the European Industry to stay competitive in the long-term

  • For Design: a portfolio or shipped work that shows taste, systems thinking, and ability to simplify complexity

  • For Engineering: comfort with a modern stack (TypeScript, Python, or similar), shipped projects, and an instinct for clean, fast iteration

Where our previous interns work now

After Tacto, over 10 former interns have founded their own companies, with e.g. 3 already going through Y Combinator. Others have joined programs like CDTM (5+ acceptances), moved into top tech firms, or joined early-stage startups and VCs. The common thread: they all got a real understanding of what it takes to build and scale a company.

Our Background

Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material.

Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans.

Why It Matters

Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives.

But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI.

Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech.

What We Offer

The people at Tacto are passionate about building the organization, growing themselves, and our product while having fun and being real. We have high expectations, great talent density, and a culture where your ambition, performance, and agency are what count - not where you come from or how big your ego is. You'll grow at the forefront of AI, have real ownership and impact, and be surrounded by the best people in their field who challenge you and make you better every day. That is demanding and rewarding, but that's where we thrive. Besides that you have:

  • Money: Competitive salary & equity in the company with real upside, so you are invested in our success

  • Workplace: A vibrant in-office culture (> 4 days/week) in a beautiful office in central Munich

  • Development: A development budget and regular exposure to exceptional people, e.g., Lunch & Learns, peer mentoring, external speakers

  • Freetime: 26 + 4 vacation days per year (4 fixed “company rest days”) as well as regular off-sites and team events

  • Health: Wellpass membership, of course, a fruit basket (!), and access to Jobrad, for your health

  • Family & Social Security: Voluntary pension contribution, voluntary KITA subsidy for your children

Tacto is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.

sequoia-tourlane:ashbyhq:5fe521ba-7d56-4.descriptionHtml:
EXPLORE YOUR NEXT ADVENTURE WITH US!

Willkommen bei Tourlane! Wir sind eine Tech Company, die es sich zur Aufgabe gemacht hat, das beste Reiseerlebnis für unsere Kunden zu schaffen.

Wir bieten vollständig personalisierte Reisen zu 35+ Reisezielen auf der ganzen Welt, Tendenz steigend. Mit über 100.000 Reisenden in der DACH-Region und Frankreich sind wir auf dem Weg, Europas führendes Reiseunternehmen zu werden. Wir wissen, dass Urlaubszeit kostbar ist. Unser Ziel ist es, unseren Kunden zu helfen, die Welt zu entdecken und bleibende Erinnerungen zu schaffen. Wir konzentrieren uns darauf, maßgeschneiderte Erlebnisse für unsere Kunden zu schaffen, denn wir glauben, dass das Leben zu kurz für Standardreisen ist.

Wir suchen Customer Success Managers, die sich unserem Customer Service Team anschließen und mit auf unsere Reise gehen.

 

WAS SIND DEINE AUFGABEN?

  • Du bist Ansprechpartner:in nach der Reisebuchung und sorgst du mit kreativen Lösungen und klarem Überblick über alle Anfragen für ein reibungsloses Kundenerlebnis.

  • Du informierst und berätst selbstständig unsere Kund:innen hinsichtlich Änderungen in ihrer Reiseplanung.

  • Du erkennst potenzielle Herausforderungen frühzeitig, vermeidest Eskalationen und löst Anliegen der Kund:innen durch proaktive Maßnahmen.

  • Du schätzt eigenständiges Arbeiten und hast Freude daran, Anfragen der Kund:innen eigenverantwortlich zu lösen.

  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine eigenen Leistungs- und Buchungs-KPIs und sorgst dafür, dass Anliegen der Kund:innen professionell und engagiert bearbeitet werden.

 

WAS BRAUCHST DU FÜR DEINEN ERFOLG BEI UNS?

Hier ist die Erfahrung, die wir von dir erwarten:

  • Du teilst deine Leidenschaft für das Reisen mit uns und unseren Kund:innen. Deine Hingabe zum perfekten Kundenservice ist deine Motivation.

  • Du verfügst bereits über wertvolle Erfahrung im Kundenservice am Telefon und per E-Mail sowie in der Anwendung von Service-Software-Tools.

  • Deine lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise, ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und der Wunsch, unsere Kund:innen rundum zufriedenzustellen, zeichnen dich aus.

  • Du verfügst über ausgeprägte organisatorische Fähigkeiten und bist in der Lage, mehrere Kund:innen gleichzeitig effektiv zu betreuen.

  • Mit exzellenten Deutsch- und guten Englischkenntnissen in Wort und Schrift erfüllst du die sprachlichen Anforderungen. Zudem ist dein Hauptwohnsitz in Deutschland.

  • Ab dem 1. August bist du bereit, dein aufregendes Abenteuer bei Tourlane zu starten.

Außerdem sind dies die Kompetenzen, wonach wir schauen:

  • Kunden- & Partnerorientierung – Du verstehst die Bedürfnisse unserer Kund:innen und Partner:innen und sorgst mit deinem Einsatz für ein reibungsloses Reiseerlebnis.

  • Kommunikationsstärke – Du kannst dich klar, professionell und gleichzeitig freundlich ausdrücken – sowohl mündlich als auch schriftlich.

  • Problemlösungskompetenz – Du gehst Herausforderungen proaktiv an und findest pragmatische Lösungen, auch wenn es mal komplex wird.

  • Organisationstalent – Du behältst auch bei mehreren parallel laufenden Anfragen den Überblick, setzt Prioritäten und arbeitest zuverlässig.

  • Belastbarkeit & Resilienz – Du bleibst auch in stressigen Situationen ruhig, fokussiert und lösungsorientiert.

  • Teamgeist & Kooperationsfähigkeit – Du arbeitest gerne mit Kolleg:innen zusammen und unterstützt, wo es gebraucht wird.

 

What we offer:

  • Wir teilen deine Leidenschaft für das Reisen: genieße es, mit unserem neuen Programm auch bis zu 5 Monate im Ausland zu arbeiten.

  • Wir unterstützen all die verschiedenen Communities, die uns zu Tourlane machen: Tritt einer Employee Resource Group (ERG) bei oder gründe eine weitere ERG und vernetze dich mit Tourlaneans.

  • Hundefreundliches Office: Wir können es kaum erwarten, deinen Vierbeiner kennenzulernen! 

  • Ein umfassendes Onboarding: Wir bringen dir in unserem Customer Service Onboarding alles bei, was du brauchst, um bei uns erfolgreich zu sein.

 

Klingt spannend? Wir freuen uns auf dich!

somacap-etched:ashbyhq:ca25e600-e2e8-411.title: DFT (Design For Test) Engineer
somacap-etched:ashbyhq:ca25e600-e2e8-411.descriptionHtml:
About Etched

Etched is building the world’s first AI inference system purpose-built for transformers - delivering over 10x higher performance and dramatically lower cost and latency than a B200. With Etched ASICs, you can build products that would be impossible with GPUs, like real-time video generation models and extremely deep & parallel chain-of-thought reasoning agents. Backed by hundreds of millions from top-tier investors and staffed by leading engineers, Etched is redefining the infrastructure layer for the fastest growing industry in history.

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Design For Testability (DFT) Engineer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring the robust testability of integrated circuits (ICs) from the design phase through to production. This role is crucial in improving the efficiency and effectiveness of our testing processes, thereby enhancing overall product quality.

Key responsibilities

  • Develop and implement robust Design for Test (DFT) architectures for ASIC and SoC designs to enhance test coverage, debug capability, and fault isolation.

  • Integrate industry-standard DFT methodologies such as scan insertion, boundary scan, Built-In Self-Test (BIST), and Memory BIST (MBIST).

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with design and verification teams to ensure DFT requirements are addressed early and consistently throughout the design cycle.

  • Analyze test results and silicon debug data to provide design feedback and drive improvements in coverage, yield, and reliability.

  • Create and execute comprehensive DFT verification plans to validate the correct implementation and functionality of all DFT features.

  • Apply simulation-based and formal verification techniques to ensure high confidence in DFT logic correctness.

  • Conduct internal DFT audits and design reviews to proactively identify and resolve gaps in testability or coverage.

  • Support silicon bring-up, debug, and failure analysis during post-silicon validation to ensure successful product launch.

  • Partner with test engineering teams to develop and optimize Automated Test Equipment (ATE) programs for volume production.

  • Generate production-quality test patterns and ensure robust failure analysis capability in high-volume environments.

  • Collaborate with manufacturing and quality teams to implement data-driven test process improvements and monitor long-term product health.

  • Ensure test strategies are aligned with product milestones, manufacturing timelines, and quality/reliability targets.

  • Author and maintain detailed documentation for DFT architecture, test plans, procedures, and debug guides.

  • Share best practices through training sessions, onboarding, and mentorship to enhance DFT awareness across design and test teams.

  • Stay current with emerging DFT technologies, industry trends, and evolving standards to continually improve internal methodologies.

You may be a good fit if you have

  • 10+ years of experience in DFT engineering with a track record of successful test implementations for ASIC or SoC products.

  • A deep understanding of digital design, verification methodologies, and DFT implementation practices.

  • Proficiency in System Verilog and fluency with industry-standard EDA tools (e.g., Synopsys DFT Compiler, Cadence Encounter Test, Mentor Tessent).

  • Scripting and automation experience using Python, Perl, or TCL to streamline DFT implementation and test processes.

  • Track record of leading DFT initiatives across multiple product generations in high-performance or high-volume silicon environments.

  • Strong analytical and debugging skills, with the ability to work across teams to resolve complex testability issues.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities, with a focus on clarity and cross-functional alignment.

  • A Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field (Master’s preferred).

Strong candidates may also have experience with

  • Mixed-signal DFT methodologies and integration of analog testability into SoC workflows.

  • Industry standards such as IEEE 1149.1 (JTAG), IEEE 1500, and experience applying them in complex designs.

  • Yield analysis, product engineering, and contributions to test cost reduction and quality improvement programs.

Benefits

  • Medical, dental, and vision packages with generous premium coverage

    • $500 per month credit for waiving medical benefits

  • Housing subsidy of $2k per month for those living within walking distance of the office

  • Relocation support for those moving to San Jose (Santana Row)

  • Various wellness benefits covering fitness, mental health, and more

  • Daily lunch + dinner in our office

  • Unlimited compute budget subject to ROI justification

How we’re different

Etched believes in the Bitter Lesson. We think most of the progress in the AI field has come from using more FLOPs to train and run models, and the best way to get more FLOPs is to build model-specific hardware. Larger and larger training runs encourage companies to consolidate around fewer model architectures, which creates a market for single-model ASICs.

We are a fully in-person team in San Jose (Santana Row), and greatly value engineering skills. We do not have boundaries between engineering and research, and we expect all of our technical staff to contribute to both as needed.

Check us out on RepVue!
 
What you'll do
 
As a Sales Engineer for Smart Trac at Tractian, you will be responsible for driving sales of our advanced tracking and monitoring solutions. Your role involves leveraging your technical expertise to understand client needs in asset tracking and maintenance, demonstrating how Smart Trac offers superior solutions, and facilitating the sales process from initial contact through to successful implementation, using HubSpot CRM to manage client interactions.
  • Engage with potential clients to understand their asset monitoring and maintenance needs, positioning Smart Trac as a leading solution.

somacap-tractian:lever:95e8f44f-75e3-416.title: Software Engineering Manager
somacap-tractian:lever:95e8f44f-75e3-416.descriptionHtml:
Engineering at TRACTIAN
 
The Engineering team at TRACTIAN is responsible for building and scaling the infrastructure that powers our products. We work with massive volumes of IoT data, real-time streams, and mission-critical services that demand performance, resilience, and reliability. Backend and Integrations teams play a vital role in ensuring our platform seamlessly connects with the external ecosystem of ERPs, CRMs, and other mission-critical enterprise tools, while also driving scalability and robustness across Tractian’s backend architecture.
 
 
What you'll do
 
As a Software Engineering Manager, you will lead a cross-functional group of engineers focused on backend services and enterprise integrations. You’ll partner closely with the Product team and engineering managers to ensure smooth delivery of engineering projects, and collaborate with directors and technical leads to shape the strategic vision of backend systems and integrations at Tractian. This role blends technical depth with people management, requiring you to support engineers in their growth while ensuring technical excellence and timely delivery.
  • Lead and mentor backend software engineers, fostering technical excellence, ownership, and career growth.
  • Partner with Product and Commercial teams to scope, plan, and prioritize backend and integration initiatives.
  • Drive architectural decisions to ensure scalable, resilient backend systems and reliable integrations with enterprise software (SAP, TOTVS, Oracle, etc.).
  • Ensure the team’s deliverables align with Tractian’s broader engineering strategy and contribute to business impact.
  • Represent the team in cross-department initiatives, managing stakeholder communication and setting expectations.
  • Optimize resource allocation, define priorities, and oversee project timelines to maximize efficiency and results.
  • Promote a culture of high-quality engineering through code reviews, observability practices, and process improvements.
  • Collaborate with other engineering leaders to set standards for backend development, integration patterns, and security practices.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Proven experience as a Software Engineering Manager or in a technical leadership role.
  • Strong technical background in backend development, with expertise in at least one programming language (Python, Go, or Node.js).
  • Hands-on experience with relational and non-relational databases (especially PostgreSQL and MongoDB).
  • Knowledge of distributed systems, microservices, and event-driven architectures.
  • Familiarity with enterprise integration patterns and security best practices.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to thrive under strict deadlines.
  • Strong communication skills for managing stakeholders and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Experience in high-SLA environments with mission-critical systems.
  • Advanced/Fluent proficiency in English and Portuguese.
  • Experience with ERP software integrations (SAP, TOTVS, Oracle) or other enterprise systems.
  • Background in event streaming and data pipelines (Kafka, Airflow, Dagster, or Temporal).
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms and containerized environments (Kubernetes, Docker).
  • Previous experience in startups or high-growth environments.
  • Advanced/Fluent proficiency in Spanish.

southparkcommons-centari:ashbyhq:caa2eb9.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend
southparkcommons-centari:ashbyhq:caa2eb9.descriptionHtml:
About Centari

At Centari, we believe that in high-stakes dealmaking, the competitive edge lies within unlocking your firm's private deal data. Centari is building the deal intelligence platform for the future of law and finance, moving beyond simple automation and into a world of data-driven dealmaking. Our proprietary Deal Reasoning Engine transforms a firm’s goldmine of complex documents into strategic insights, empowering global deal teams to negotiate with the full force of their organization’s collective knowledge.

Our platform spans M&A, credit finance, fund formation, and real estate. Every deal a firm runs through Centari makes the next one sharper, giving deal teams a clearer view of the market than anyone on the other side of the table.
Today, Ropes & Gray, Willkie, Fried Frank, Wilson Sonsini, and practices across the AmLaw 25 and Magic Circle rely on Centari. We're backed by GTMfund, Jeremy Kranz (former DoorDash board), Andy Appelbaum (Seamless), Jack Altman, South Park Commons, and Recall Capital.

We are drawn to complexity because that is where true innovation happens. If you’re a builder who thrives in ambiguity and operates with radical ownership, we’d love to meet you.

For more information, check out centari.com or find us on LinkedIn.

About the Role

We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer, Backend to join our product team. You'll be a key player in designing and building Centari's core AI technology, working alongside engineers who share a bias for action. As one team, you'll write code, shape the product, interact with customers, and drive initiatives from concept to completion.

Our systems are built with Go and React/TypeScript, leveraging cutting-edge LLM technologies across infrastructure, search, and persistence layers. If you're passionate about building impactful LLM applications and thrive on owning complex challenges, we want to hear from you.

Requirements

  • At least 7+ years of experience building production-ready applications in Go or another strongly typed language.

  • Some experience with or strong interest in LLMs, knowledge graphs, semantic search, and other AI/ML technologies.

  • Proven ability to work with cutting-edge technology and eagerness to learn new skills.

  • Willingness to roll up sleeves and get things done - our engineers are comfortable switching between different technical domains as needed.

  • Strong collaboration skills and ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experience as a tech lead or driving projects end to end.

Nice to have

  • Experience in enterprise SaaS or with highly regulated industries (e.g., legal, financial services, healthcare).

  • Experience in a startup environment.

  • Specialized experience and skills in either full-stack product development or data/ML infrastructure.

What we offer

  • Build at the frontier of AI for knowledge work, with a highly engaged user base from top firms.

  • Flat organizational structure promoting autonomy and direct impact.

  • Competitive salary and equity in a high-growth startup

  • Comprehensive health benefits (Centari covering 100% of employee premiums)

  • Dental and Vision (Centari covering 75% of employee premiums)

  • 401(k) match up to 4%

  • Hybrid work culture based in NYC, with lunch covered for in-office days

  • Flexible PTO

uppartners-hermeus:lever:e078ecc7-87a9-4.title: Senior Strategic Sourcing Manager, Indirect
uppartners-hermeus:lever:e078ecc7-87a9-4.descriptionHtml:
Hermeus is a venture-backed defense aviation company reclaiming the lost art of rapid iterative prototyping to build the fastest aircraft in the world today. By prioritizing relentless hardware iteration, we deliver high-speed systems at the pace of the modern battlefield. We work with the Department of War to provide the high-speed capabilities our nation and its allies need to maintain a durable, asymmetric advantage.

About The Role:

We are seeking a Senior Strategic Sourcing Manager, Indirect to lead sourcing strategy and supplier management across critical indirect spend categories within a fast-paced aerospace and defense environment. This is a highly strategic role focused on building scalable sourcing frameworks, driving supplier performance, and supporting rapid company growth from development through production scale-up.

You will own end-to-end sourcing activities across categories such as Professional Services, Software/SaaS, IT Infrastructure, Facilities, Capital Equipment, and Corporate Services. The ideal candidate is highly autonomous, commercially strong, operationally minded, and comfortable operating in ambiguity while partnering cross-functionally with Engineering, Manufacturing, Finance, Legal, IT, and Executive Leadership.

  • Develop and execute sourcing strategies across indirect procurement categories including Professional Services, Software/SaaS, IT, Facilities, and Capital Equipment
  • Lead end-to-end sourcing activities including supplier selection, RFP/RFQ management, negotiations, contracting, and supplier onboarding
  • Drive supplier negotiations focused on cost, scalability, risk mitigation, quality, and long-term partnerships
  • Partner cross-functionally with Engineering, Manufacturing, Finance, IT, Legal, and Operations teams to support company priorities
  • Build scalable procurement processes and category management strategies to support rapid organizational growth
  • Establish supplier performance metrics and drive continuous improvement across cost, delivery, and operational efficiency
  • Support infrastructure expansion, CapEx initiatives, and operational build-outs tied to company scaling efforts
  • Identify opportunities for procurement optimization, spend visibility improvements, and process automation
  • Influence stakeholders and leadership through data-driven sourcing recommendations and market intelligence
  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, Operations, Finance, or related field
  • 10+ years of experience in strategic sourcing, procurement, or supply chain within a high-growth or technical environment
  • Strong experience managing indirect spend categories such as Professional Services, Software/SaaS, IT, Facilities, or CapEx
  • Proven experience building sourcing strategies and procurement processes within startup or scaling organizations
  • Strong commercial negotiation and supplier management experience involving complex agreements and contracts
  • Experience partnering cross-functionally with Engineering, Manufacturing, Finance, IT, and Legal organizations
  • Strong analytical, operational, and stakeholder management capabilities
  • Ability to operate autonomously and drive initiatives with minimal oversight
  • Experience managing multiple sourcing initiatives simultaneously under aggressive timelines
  • Aerospace, defense, advanced manufacturing, robotics, automotive, or hardware startup experience
  • Experience supporting organizations transitioning from R&D into scaled production environments
  • Familiarity with supplier industrialization, manufacturing scale-up, and infrastructure expansion efforts
  • Experience supporting sourcing initiatives within regulated or security-conscious environments
  • Strong understanding of ERP, procurement, and spend management systems
  • Experience sourcing Software/SaaS, cloud infrastructure, technical consulting, or enterprise IT services
  • MBA, CPSM, CPM, CIPS, or related procurement certifications preferred
  • Experience developing procurement KPIs, dashboards, and operational reporting frameworks
  • Demonstrated success influencing cross-functional teams in fast-paced, execution-focused environments
    • U.S. EXPORT CONTROL COMPLIANCE STATUS 
    The person hired will have access to information and items subject to U.S. export controls, and therefore, must either be a “U.S. person” as defined by 22 C.F.R. § 120.62 or otherwise eligible for deemed export licensing. US persons include U.S. citizens, U.S. nationals, lawful permanent residents (green card holders), and asylees and refugees with such status granted, not pending. 
     
    EQUAL OPPORTUNITY
    Hermeus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions at Hermeus are based solely on merit, competence, and qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability, or any other legally protected status.

xange-knowunity:ashbyhq:92babcfd-0144-42.descriptionHtml:
ABOUT US

We are building a future where every student on the planet can access, enjoy, and benefit from the highest quality education. Since founding Knowunity straight out of high school in 2020, we've been committed to revolutionising how students learn.

Millions of students already use our AI learning companion weekly. We just raised €27m from strong Investors - one of Europe’s largest education rounds in the past years. The AI learning market is at an inflection point, finally enabling true personalisation at scale, and we're determined to build the first AI learning unicorn in this space.

You will join a truly driven team of 60 hands-on builders serving 1 billion students worldwide. If we execute on our product vision, you will have built something that transforms education globally.

This is your chance to be part of building a generational company.

Your mission

If you’re exceptional, we’ll make room for you.

We’re building the first AI learning unicorn. Millions of students use Knowunity already - and we’re just getting started.

Your story

  • You’ve built and shipped something impressive

  • You’re a top growth, product, AI, or engineering talent

  • You want to own something end-to-end and move fast

  • You’re not here to coast - you’re here to win

What we offer

Not for everyone, everything for the right ones.

  • Competitive compensation and equity: We’re are building Knowunity to dominate the global AI learning market. Your compensation package includes competitive salary paired with meaningful equity in a company with genuine unicorn potential. Team members who help us reach that goal will be rewarded accordingly.

  • Elite team and true ownership: You’ll work alongside 60 exceptional people who match your ambition within a flat hierarchy - direct access to founders and leadership without bureaucratic middle layers. You'll own entire areas from conception to delivery with real decision-making authority.

  • Meaningful impact at scale: Your work will have immediate, measurable impact on education globally and directly improves how millions of students learn.

  • Benefits: 28 days annual leave +1 extra day per year with Knowunity, 40 days work from anywhere, personal development budget, mental health support via Nilo, Urban Sports Club, monthly become1 retail vouchers, team and company events

We’re not here to coast - we are building something exceptional. We’re a lean team of ambitious people who push hard, move fast, and constantly raise the bar. The real perk is not standard benefits - it’s joining 60 amazing people who challenge you to level up daily. If you’re hungry, thrive under pressure and ready to go the extra mile, this is where you will accelerate your career faster than anywhere else.

Our Tech Stack
Our app is written in Flutter with Riverpod. Our Golang backend is powered by PostgreSQL and hosted on AWS with Kubernetes. Our AI stack uses several LLM providers (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic, and Mistral) plus in-house models. Our data stack consists of BigQuery and dbt.

How to apply

Send us...

  1. Your CV + LinkedIn

  2. A sharp role pitch:

    • What would you own?

    • What problems would you solve and how?

    • Why you?

  3. One thing you built that proves you’re exceptional
